cases.refreshed: Join our group and read in silence with others in our cozy fireplace/magazine area. Bring your own book and quiet snacks, or select one from our collection here at the Vineland Library. After an hour of quiet reading, everyone can share what they are reading with the group and whether they'd recommend it to others and why. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Come join the teen-led group NeuroSphere! This session will dive into the basics of brain function, fun activities to test your brainpower, and an introduction to future career opportunities. There will be snacks; feel free to bring a friend! We're a group of high school students driven by a passion for neuroscience and the wonders of the brain. Our mission is to inspire curiosity and spark a love for science in younger students by creating engaging, hands-on learning experiences. Through NeuroSphere, we hope to share our knowledge, connect with the community, and encourage the next generation of future scientists and innovators! Questions? Email neurosphereyouth@gmail.com.
